evidence_boundary: Current-run measurements are local CPython/SQLite synthetic microbenchmarks and injected-failure mechanism tests. They are not live-FRANK, Android, target-Qwen, distributed, production-security or production-database estimates.

dataset.vector_scoring: in-process exact scoring over FTS candidate subset

experiments.workload: Each operation performed exact state read + graph neighbors + FTS candidates + vector top-5 ranking. Query-result identity was checked equal on 20 random samples before timing.
experiments.interpretation: In this embedded cache-hot workload, physical consolidation was roughly 2x slower at p50 than the specialized path. A single physical database is therefore not an automatic latency win.

experiments.workload: Same logical read, but the specialized arm crossed separate JSON serialization/deserialization boundaries while the unified logical API emitted one combined boundary.
experiments.interpretation: Logical unification reduced p50 by about 10.15% in this constructed service-boundary workload by removing explicit serialization crossings. This supports unifying the API/plan before forcing storage consolidation.

The monolith had the lowest p50 write here, but tail spikes were large/noisy and the outbox arm paid synchronous-consumption overhead. The result is a placement tradeoff signal, not a universal winner.

cases.fault: fail after authoritative state commit before graph commit
fail after canonical state+outbox commit before graph derivation

experiments.interpretation: A single transaction gives clean atomic rollback when all required data lives in one engine. When derived planes remain heterogeneous, a canonical authoritative commit plus durable outbox/derivation receipt makes lag explicit and replayable instead of pretending arbitrary cross-engine atomicity.

reused_fresh_G11_calibration.result: Scoped validation rejected all 16,101 required-basis-invalid cases while global validation added 41,630 false rejects (13.8767% of 300,000) due unrelated domain changes in the synthetic workload.
Latency-winner fractions in synthetic cost surface: specialized 12.232%, logical API 5.811%, hybrid 54.170%, monolith 27.787%; no universal winner.
Top-5 candidate set changed in 54.224% of 50,000 plan perturbations while record bytes stayed unchanged.
JSON roundtrip 153.499 us/op versus compact handle creation 0.1067 us/op; operations were not semantically equivalent end-to-end.

conclusion: Current evidence supports semantic/logical unification plus an authoritative event/state commit spine and replayable derived sidecars as the default candidate. Physical consolidation should remain subplan/workload-specific and benchmark-gated.
